name: Itsukushima Ryouko
source: The principal of the school with a strong feminist ideology. She is a large-hearted women who is well liked by her female student. On the other hand, she sees men as incompetent and scum, and behaves unprofessionally. She has an informal dress, and her clothes are quite revealing. She doesn't see men as human, and is unafraid to expose herself in front of them.
